Name: Sweetheart Pink Cabin- Paint Option- Neighbour Cabin
Author: laralasagna
Description:
This mod adds a pink sweetheart-themed cabin design that can be selected as a paint option through Robin’s "paint buildings" menu or by using the paint bucket. It’s designed to blend in with the vanilla game and give the cabins a cuter look! There's also a winter snowy version! :)

Important notes: 
- Works in multiplayer.
- Compatible with mods that let you use building paint buckets/tools (as far as I've tested).
- Due to certain stardew mechanics, this paint option [b]replaces[/b] 3 vanilla cabin designs. To regain access to those designs, you would have to uninstall this mod.
- As you know, at Robin's, you can only paint buildings that are at maximum upgrade level. However, you can use this paint on your cabin at any level using mods that give you paint buckets/tools.
